name: Netify
description: Agent-native accounts receivable and relational trade credit recovery workspace for African SMEs

tools.name: get_collection_priority
tools.description: Retrieve prioritized debtor accounts ranked by urgency, aging days, risk score, and broken commitments from the live collections queue.

limit.description: Maximum number of priority customers to return (default: 10)

currency.description: Currency filter e.g. NGN, KES, GHS, USD

tools.name: search_customers
tools.description: Search customer accounts by business name or address with live ledger balances and risk status.

query.description: Customer name or location to search

tools.name: get_customer_evidence
tools.description: Fetch detailed debtor evidence for a specific customer: active invoices, historical payments, WhatsApp/SMS commitment logs, and past collection activities.

customerId.description: The unique ID of the customer account

tools.name: get_customer_risk_profile
tools.description: Retrieve AI-grounded risk explanation, behavioral patterns, and recommended recovery strategy for a customer.

customerId.description: The unique ID of the customer account

tools.name: draft_follow_up_message
tools.description: Generate a culturally appropriate, evidence-grounded collection reminder draft for a customer with specific channel and tone in 6 regional languages (English, Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, Pidgin, Fulfulde). Does NOT send message without human review.

tools.name: record_collection_activity
tools.description: Persist a verified collection activity record or customer payment promise into the live timeline. Requires human review.

type.description: Activity type e.g. PAYMENT_REMINDER, FOLLOW_UP, CALL

channel.description: Channel e.g. WHATSAPP, SMS, PHONE, IN_PERSON

tools.name: list_receivables
tools.description: Query live invoices and receivables filtered by status (OPEN, OVERDUE, PAID) or customer ID.

tools.name: create_payment_commitment
tools.description: Record a customer promise-to-pay date and amount into the live database. Requires human confirmation.

amount.description: Amount the customer promised to pay

promisedFor.description: Date customer promised to pay (ISO 8601 string)
